field_edits.updated_text: Five non-rib-bearing lumbar vertebral bodies are identified. Mild levoconvex lumbar scoliosis is present. Lumbar vertebral body heights are maintained without acute compression deformity. Alignment is maintained without spondylolisthesis. Mild degenerative changes of the sacroiliac joints are seen. Normal density is preserved. No acute osseous abnormality of the lumbar spine.
There is mild disc space narrowing at L4-L5 and L5-S1. The remaining disc spaces are preserved.
Moderate retained colonic stool burden is noted.

impression:
1. Mild multilevel lumbar spondylosis with degenerative disc disease, greatest at L4-L5 and L5-S1.
2. Mild lower lumbar facet arthropathy.
3. Mild levoconvex lumbar scoliosis.
4. Mild degenerative changes of the sacroiliac joints.
5. No acute osseous abnormality.
